summary: John's 5th-great-grandfather; coal miner at Lickfinn in the Slieveardagh coalfield, Gortnahoe parish, Tipperary - earliest known Heffernan ancestor.
bio: Humphrey Heffernan was a miner living at Lickfin (Lickfinn), parish of Gortnahoe, barony of Slieveardagh, Co. Tipperary, flourishing 1805-1817. He married Anastasia Ryan (record not found). Their children were Lawrence (c.1805-1842), Richard (bapt. 3 May 1806), Thomas (bapt. 10 Sep 1808), James (bapt. 1812), Humphrey (1815), William (1817) and Patrick; the parentage of Lawrence and Patrick is probable. Two sons, James and Patrick, were transported to New South Wales after the 1834 killing of Constable Feeney at Ballynonty. Added to the tree in Round 2 (replacing the tree's Patrick Heffernan/Catherine Neagle line).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
